{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America opposes United States military intervention in the civil war in Syria.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America supports the secular pro-democracy elements in the mass Syrian uprising against the Assad regime.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"U.S. military power cannot liberate the Syrian people.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America urges its members and friends to lobby Congress to reject the president’s request for the authorization of the use of force against Syria.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The international community must condemn the use of chemical weapons on civilians in Syria.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The international community must support the United Nations inspectors’ efforts to discover the perpetrators of violence involving chemical weapons in Syria.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Even if it is determined that the Assad regime used chemical weapons, a unilateral air strike by the United States would not cease that threat.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"U.S. air power cannot surgically take out individuals who can deploy chemical weapons.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A U.S. air strike will kill many innocent civilians.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"United States troops on the ground only serve to increase the level of violence in civil wars, based on experience in Iraq and Afghanistan.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
